parts.title: A Fog That Makes You Forget?! | TheOneApp Promo 1 #Shorts
parts.description:
The Forgetting Fog rolls into TheOneApp Station and the light goes out. Pip, Momo and Basil need a scientist to close the circuit. Are you the one? A short adventure from TheOneApp, the science study app for Primary 3 to 6 in Singapore.

Parents: see TheOneApp and try it free for 7 days at https://theoneapp.sg

The only app you need to learn Science: TheOneApp.
